cscgeneration2-cscgeneration-2:lever:825.description: With over 58 stores and the largest avocational cooking program in the US, Sur La Table offers an unsurpassed selection of exclusive and premium-quality goods for the kitchen and table – and the culinary expertise and inspiration to go along with it. Whether the job entails interacting with our customers, driving digital growth, or providing vital behind-the-scenes support, we’re all here for the same reason – to roll up our sleeves and create happiness through cooking and sharing good food. Position Overview As a Chef Instructor, Savory at Sur La Table, you are the in-store expert and advocate for all things savory cooking. You deliver #bestincenter service, a company-wide standard for excellence in service, by sharing specialized knowledge in culinary techniques, cooking fundamentals, and personalized instruction that supports all company initiatives. The Chef Instructor, Savory plays a key role in inspiring a love for cooking while driving sales of cookware, cutlery, and kitchen tools through hands-on savory classes and engaging culinary instruction. Key Responsibilities Customer Experience & Brand Representation · Represent Sur La Table’s brand and culture by creating memorable, educational experiences that inspire repeat visits and customer loyalty. · Deliver exceptional in-store culinary experiences focused on savory cooking classes that reflect Sur La Table’s passion for food, teaching, and high standards, while following provided recipes and game plans to ensure consistency and quality. · Communicate technical cooking concepts and savory techniques in a clear, encouraging, and approachable manner. · Maintains expertise by staying current on products, actively engaging in available training, and independently seeking out additional resources. Sales & Business Performance · Drive sales by upholding kitchen standards, encouraging second class sign-ups through strong customer engagement, and promoting retail items used or featured in class. · Deliver class revenue goals by ensuring high enrollment, positive reviews, and guest return rates. · Consistently meet or exceed culinary program goals by delivering exceptional classes that drive customer engagement and sales. Performance is measured by key KPIs such as second-class sign-ups, retail culinary product sales, and guest feedback through Google reviews. Team Engagement & Store Support · Assist in setting up and breakdown of classes including organizing mise en place, prepping ingredients, and cleaning workstations. · Clean and sanitize dishes and equipment promptly to ensure smooth kitchen operations. · Assist with restocking, organizing, and maintaining kitchen supplies and tools to support overall store readiness. Operations & Compliance · Ensure compliance with food safety standards, local health codes, and sanitation regulations. · Properly handle all tools, ingredients, and kitchen equipment to maintain a safe and efficient work environment. · Maintain accurate inventory levels, minimize shrink, and control supply and culinary expenses. · May handle liquor, wine, and beer in compliance with state and location alcohol regulations, company policies, including enforcing age restrictions. · Ensure store safety and cleanliness, addressing any maintenance needs promptly. · Adhere to applicable wage and hour laws. Accurately records time worked according to SLT Policy. · Model and ensure consistent adherence to all Sur La Table policies and standard operating procedures (SOPs). Our partner is looking for a Playwright Specialist Sales Engineer / Professional Services Consultant based in United States. This is a customer-facing technical role combining sales engineering, professional services, and hands-on test automation expertise. You will help organizations evaluate, implement, and scale modern application testing solutions across web and API environments. The role centers on Playwright, CI/CD integration, test architecture, diagnostics, and reliable test-data strategies. You will guide customers from technical discovery and proof of concept through implementation, optimization, and enablement. Success requires translating complex engineering challenges into practical solutions and measurable business outcomes. You’ll work closely with developers, QA leaders, security teams, procurement stakeholders, and account executives. The ideal environment is fast-moving, technically demanding, and highly focused on customer value and production-quality delivery. Lead technical discovery with customers, understanding application architectures, testing practices, delivery pipelines, security requirements, and business objectives. Design and deliver compelling demonstrations and technical presentations focused on Playwright and modern test automation workflows. Create reusable technical assets such as sample applications, migration playbooks, implementation materials, and testing standards. Analyze testing and quality data to identify trends in reliability, flakiness, execution time, coverage, and release risk. Collaborate with internal teams and customers to continuously improve adoption, testing practices, solution architecture, and overall customer outcomes. Maintain strong documentation covering customer requirements, solution designs, technical risks, proof-of-concept results, and implementation recommendations. Advanced proficiency in TypeScript or JavaScript, with the ability to produce clean, modular, documented, production-quality code. Strong understanding of web technologies, including HTML, CSS, DOM, HTTP, REST APIs, browser behavior, cookies, sessions, and authentication. Experience designing maintainable end-to-end, integration, API, and component-testing strategies.
